acceptance_ambiguities: The5-dB whole-song target uses unfitted original-clock SNR; shared-clock codec scores cannot satisfy it.
A finite corpus plus diagnostic fits cannot establish absence on every possible source.
Strict absence of introduced AM/FM has no supplied audibility threshold. Every numerical increase is disclosed; an inapplicable fit is missing proof, not a pass.
Music coherent error lines are not uniquely added hum. Silence absolute noise and quiet known-tone spectra are the decisive background controls.
The physical sample clock retains deterministic page/bank irregularities even if the offline encoder compensates their waveform effect.
Whole new cold-boot emulator traces and bank/refill proofs are required before any host candidate is accepted.
Tone phase tracking is inconclusive when the carrier explains less than80-percent of output power.

candidate_gates.snr: Whole sea-foam unfitted source-clock improvement>=5dB; common settings on all sources
candidate_gates.noise: Silence absolute error RMS and idle-whistle energy must not increase; compare coherent error lines on known controls
candidate_gates.modulation: Compare only applicable fits and reliable known-tone phase tracking; investigate every increase; missing proof must remain explicit
candidate_gates.timing: Actual native/Fuse pulse schedule and largest hold; no new disk/RAM-bank pause; average source drift and periodic disturbance reported separately

whole_song_instruction_derived_clock.scope: All actual transport intervals; source independent; mean drift separated from periodic disturbance; no waveform or fitted SNR
whole_song_instruction_derived_clock.limitation: A transport irregularity may be compensated by offline waveform encoding; this does not make the physical sample clock uniform. The largest hold is evidence, not by itself proof of an audible pause.

whole_song_authenticated_legacy_clock.scope: All actual transport intervals; source independent; mean drift separated from periodic disturbance; no waveform or fitted SNR
whole_song_authenticated_legacy_clock.limitation: A transport irregularity may be compensated by offline waveform encoding; this does not make the physical sample clock uniform. The largest hold is evidence, not by itself proof of an audible pause.

decision: No unconditional new release passes all artifact requirements on these host diagnostics. SNR gains and every diagnostic regression remain separate; full new emulator and missing artifact proof are required.
